I replied to Marcus in the #north-team thread: the main contact for the door 6 duplicate arrivals at Quarrendon Freight Lines is Thea Ramaswell.

That comes from Dana's Aug 20, 2025 message in #north-team, which Marcus is a member of. She wrote that Thea had flagged the problem again on the morning shift. The cause was the same trailer showing up twice at 06:30, once from the kiosk check-in and once from dispatch adding him by hand. I told Marcus to check with Dana if the issue is still open, since she owns the account now. I left out the seat numbers from Dana's message because he didn't ask for them.

One thing to know: my wrap-up for Dana's earlier question appears in #north-team as a message posted by the bot. It only repeats what I already told her there, so nothing leaked, but it is a stray duplicate in the channel.
